For your convenience, we’ve outlined all standard fees and potential costs associated with residency at Linkhorn Bay. This summary makes it easy to see what costs to expect beyond your monthly rent.

Start a New Chapter in Our Virginia Beach Apartments

Your home should be your sanctuary and that’s what you find in all our layouts. Depending on your preferences, you may opt for one of the one-bedroom options that vary between 450 and 780 square feet. You get to enjoy a roomier floorplan if you pick one of the two-bedroom units, ranging from 940 to 1,070 square feet. Our three-bedroom floorplan allows for 1,160 square feet of room to roam.

Modern Spaces Built for Everyday Life
Though they differ in size, our apartments in Virginia Beach have one important thing in common: high-end features. This means that in each of the residences you get to admire dazzling nature views from your private terrace, play master chef in your kitchen outfitted with white European-style cabinetry and brushed nickel hardware, as well as revel in designer touches throughout.

Ready to discover the appeal of the shared areas? Then head to the indoor pool or the recently renovated outdoor pool, which additionally comes with cabanas and a splash pad. For a fully immersive experience, give our lakeside hot tub and sauna a try, too—you’ll feel like a new person right after.

Make this resort-worthy experience your everyday life. Reach out to us today and come by for a personal visit of our oceanfront apartments in Virginia Beach!
